description_en: Re-encrypts ciphertext under a different CMK without exposing the plaintext
description_zh: 对密文进行转加密。即先将密文解密，然后将解密得到的数据或者数据密钥使用新的主密钥再次进行加密，返回加密结果
name: ReEncrypt

parameters.help_en:
The ciphertext that you want to re-encrypt.
This parameter can be the ciphertext that is returned after symmetric or asymmetric key encryption.

Symmetric encryption: the ciphertext that is returned after you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28949.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28948.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134043.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176804.html operation. Asymmetric key encryption: the data that is encrypted using a public key after you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176804.html operation, or the data that is encrypted using an asymmetric public key in an external system
parameters.help_zh:
待转加密的密文。  
该参数可以为对称加密或非对称加密返回的密文数据。  

对称加密：调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28949.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28948.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134043.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176804.html接口返回的密文数据。  

非对称加密：可以是调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176804.html接口返回的公钥加密数据，也可以是外部系统使用非对称公钥加密的数据
parameters.name: ciphertext_blob

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the master key that is used to decrypt the ciphertext.
The globally unique identifier of the master key.

You must specify this parameter when CiphertextBlob is the data that is encrypted using a public key after asymmetric key encryption
parameters.help_zh:
解密密文时使用的主密钥ID。  
主密钥的全局唯一标识符。  

当CiphertextBlob是非对称加密返回的公钥加密数据时需要指定该参数
parameters.name: source_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the key version that is used to decrypt the ciphertext.

You must specify this parameter when CiphertextBlob is the data that is encrypted using a public key after asymmetric key encryption
parameters.help_zh:
用于解密密文的密钥版本标识符。  
当CiphertextBlob是非对称加密返回的公钥加密数据时需要指定该参数
parameters.name: source_key_version_id

parameters.help_en:
If CiphertextBlob is the result of public key encryption, specify the public key encryption algorithm. For more information about the algorithms, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148130.html.
Valid values:

RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256 RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1 SM2PKE You must specify this parameter when CiphertextBlob is the data that is encrypted using a public key after asymmetric key encryption
parameters.help_zh:
CiphertextBlob是公钥加密结果时，指定公钥加密的算法。算法详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148130.html。    
取值：

RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256
RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1
SM2PKE  
  

当CiphertextBlob是非对称加密返回的公钥加密数据时需要指定该参数
parameters.name: source_encryption_algorithm

parameters.help_en:
A JSON string that consists of key-value pairs. If you specify this parameter when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28949.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28948.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134043.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176804.html operation, you must specify the same parameter to decrypt the data. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42975.html.

You must specify this parameter when CiphertextBlob is the ciphertext that is returned after symmetric encryption
parameters.help_zh:
key/value的JSON字符串。如果在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28949.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28948.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134043.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176804.html API中指定了该参数，则需要提供同样的参数才能解密，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42975.html。  
当CiphertextBlob是对称加密返回的密文数据时需要指定该参数
parameters.name: source_encryption_context

parameters.help_en: The ID of the symmetric master key that is used to re-encrypt the data after the ciphertext is decrypted
parameters.help_zh: 对密文解密后再次加密时使用的对称主密钥ID
parameters.name: destination_key_id

parameters.help_en: A JSON string that consists of key-value pairs. This parameter specifies the encryption context for the destination master key
parameters.help_zh: key/value的JSON字符串，用于目标主密钥加密时的加密上下文
parameters.name: destination_encryption_context

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the DryRun mode.

true: enables the DryRun mode.

false (default): disables the DryRun mode.

The DryRun mode is used to test API calls, verify whether you have the permissions to perform operations on the required resources, and check whether the request parameters are valid. If you enable the DryRun mode, KMS always returns a failure and a reason for the failure. The reasons for the failure include the following:

DryRunOperationError: The request would have succeeded if the DryRun parameter was not configured.

ValidationError: The parameters specified in the request are invalid.

AccessDeniedError: You are not authorized to perform the operation on the KMS resource
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启DryRun模式。

true：开启
false（默认值）：关闭

DryRun模式用于测试API调用，验证您是否具有相应资源的权限，以及请求参数是否配置正确。DryRun模式开启后，KMS会始终返回失败并提示失败原因。失败原因包含如下：

DryRunOperationError：不配置DryRun参数时，请求会成功。
ValidationError：请求中指定的参数有误。
AccessDeniedError：您无权在KMS资源上执行该操作
parameters.name: dry_run

CiphertextBlob.description_en: The ciphertext that is re-encrypted using the specified master key
CiphertextBlob.description_zh: 使用指定的主密钥进行再次加密得到的密文

KeyId.description_en:
The ID of the master key that is used to decrypt the ciphertext.
The globally unique identifier of the master key.
KeyId.description_zh:
解密密文使用的主密钥ID。  
主密钥的全局唯一标识符

KeyVersionId.description_en: The ID of the key version that is used to decrypt the ciphertext of the master key
KeyVersionId.description_zh: 主密钥下用于解密密文的密钥版本标识符

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a globally unique identifier that is generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
